'''Bronzium Brigade''' was a deadly [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] company operating in [[Torve system/Legends|Torve system]] before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="SWTOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Bronzium Brigade is mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in the treasure hunting crew skill mission "Picking the Bones."
